characters.name: Mira Voss
characters.secret: She has seen a living person without a shadow and has never told the city watch.
characters.goal: Find her missing younger brother Tomas.
characters.fear: That the disappearance of her brother is part of something much larger.
characters.arc: Mira begins as the player's first unreliable ally. Depending on choices, she can become a trusted companion, a political enemy, or the keeper of the final key.

characters.name: Captain Eloran Vale
characters.secret: He knows the royal family covered up the First Silence and believes order is worth almost any cost.
characters.goal: Prevent panic and keep the capital functioning.
characters.fear: A civil war inside the city.
characters.arc: He can become an ally, tyrant, or tragic obstacle depending on whether the player exposes the royal cover-up.

characters.name: Archivist Seren Quill
characters.secret: She has decoded part of the Hollow Star's operating language.
characters.goal: Understand the truth of the First Silence before anyone destroys the evidence.
characters.arc: Seren can give the player the knowledge needed to repair the Hollow Star—or the knowledge needed to deliberately open it.

characters.name: Tomas Voss
characters.secret: He followed a voice beneath the city and has started hearing the Hollow Star speak in his dreams.
characters.goal: Return home without bringing the thing beneath the city with him.
characters.fear: That he is becoming part of the machine.
characters.arc: Tomas can be rescued, sacrificed, or transformed. His outcome strongly affects Mira and several endings.

characters.name: Queen Nyra Vael
characters.secret: Her bloodline descends from the engineers who built the Hollow Star's prison.
characters.goal: Preserve the kingdom long enough to find a permanent solution.
characters.fear: Being forced to choose between the kingdom and the world's safety.
characters.arc: Nyra can become a patron, antagonist, sacrifice, or uneasy partner.

characters.name: The Bellkeeper
characters.secret: The Bellkeeper is one of the original seven people who survived the First Silence unchanged.
characters.goal: Stop anyone from repeating the mistake that created the Hollow Star.
characters.fear: That humanity will choose curiosity over survival again.
characters.arc: The Bellkeeper slowly reveals that the supposedly heroic history of the kingdom is a lie.

characters.name: Vesper Raine
characters.secret: Vesper believes the thing beneath the world can end all war if properly awakened.
characters.goal: Break the royal monopoly on the Hollow Star's secrets.
characters.fear: A world where the same rulers simply inherit the same lies.
characters.arc: Vesper can become a temporary ally, revolutionary leader, or final antagonist.
